text:
marina: Hey — I'm starting as a contractor today (marina@redwood-contracts.io). Got an Okta invite to the .io address but it didn't link to my Google Workspace alias. Also 1Password seat shows 'no license'. SMS MFA isn't working (international number). Who can help with temp Drive + 1Password access while IT sorts the alias + MFA?

sam-it: Hey Marina — welcome! Can you DM me your personal gmail so we can send a temp Drive share? We'll also open a ticket for the 1Password seat. For MFA: if SMS is blocked, we can set up a temporary TOTP app or a temporary bypass for initial enroll — which country is your number?

marina: Thanks Sam. DM sent: marina.personal@gmail.com. Phone is +44 7700 900123 (UK mobile). Happy to use TOTP while SMS is flaky.

sam-it: Got it. Adding you to contractors/temp-access group and sharing the onboarding folder now.

provision-bot: INC-2026 created by sam-it: "Contractor SSO alias + 1Password seat" — priority P2, ETA initial response 2h.

devex: Hey! I can assign a temporary 1Password guest share while the seat sync finishes — sending a one-off shared vault link in DM (expires 48h). Please don't store secrets there long-term. Also cc-ing infra to fix alias mapping to google alias.

sam-it: Drive share sent to marina.personal@gmail.com — you should see "Redwood Contractors Onboarding". 1Password guest share sent. For Okta -> Google alias mapping, infra flagged a domain alias mismatch (redwood-contracts.io not auto-mapped). They're going to add a scoped mapping; I'll update INC-2026.

marina: I can access Drive link + 1Password guest OK. Thanks! Quick Q: I need SSH access to private repos for the first-week tasks — who adds me to the GitHub org?

sam-it: We'll add you to the "contractors" GitHub team once you DM a public SSH key and confirm your handle. If you prefer, we can add email-based invite to your personal gmail too.

zoe: Welcome Marina! People Ops sent the onboarding checklist and contractor agreement in DM. Ping me if payroll or expense access is needed. :wave:

provision-bot: INC-2026 status updated — infra assigned, ETA alias fix 6-8 hours. 1Password seat requested from licensing team.

marina: Appreciate the fast help everyone. I'll DM the SSH key now and follow up if MFA alias still misbehaves.

sam-it: Perfect. Once infra confirms alias mapping I'll re-run the SSO sync so your .io -> google alias becomes canonical. In the meantime, continue with the temp access flow. :thumbsup:
